integrity.finite_verification: canonical multiplication and exhaustive relations at 1, 2, 3 leaves; exact formula checked through 5 leaves

limitations: Identity-preserving labeled endomorphisms of outward directed stars with at least one leaf. A prior general Boolean admissibility theorem implicitly specifies endomorphisms at each fixed size. No claim of classification of all oriented trees or conjugacy orbits. Finite exhaustive verification only through three leaves.
title: Exact endomorphism census and three-mode concentration for oriented-star Hecke–Kiselman monoids
